about: Every in-game bug report (bug-reports branch, reports/<ts>-<id>/) that was a gameplay or logic bug, mapped to the test that guards it. status: new = added by this suite; covered = an earlier fix already has a test; pending-pr = its test is in an open PR (run once the spec is present); live-regression = the test fails on the current head and is held as XFAIL in tests/regression/test_regressions.py (KNOWN_LIVE) until the fix lands. Fixtures are the reporters' saves copied verbatim.

issues.description: AI Scribe free cast resolved nothing
issues.note: The save in the report is empty ({}), so the existing synthetic test from #55 is the guard.

issues.description: Duel: human outbid twice and the turn ended
Familiar gather and its cast read as two Newt turns
issues.note: One move (summon Vulpes for gather, cast Mana Drain) logged cast-first. Fixed by #115 and #116.

issues.description: Tower cost ignored Perfect Reagent / Inexpensive
AI with the lead did not build the last tower to win
issues.note: As saved Newt trailed 48-54, so not ending the game was right (passes). With Newt leading 48-26 the master lookahead still picks research over the winning build (XFAIL 118-lead).

issues.description: AI turn ended after losing its own auction
AI gave up after two lost bids
Familiar New Research showed one spell, not four
Rise did not let the player pick a familiar
issues.note: Keith owned no familiar, so Rise had no target (correct). The test also gives him one and checks the pick and use flow.

issues.description: Scry Dungeon showed nothing about the gold kept
issues.note: Tests land with #137; the e2e spec joins the regression run as soon as it is on the branch under test.

issues.description: Scry Familiar gather ended the turn before the cast
Gather keep rings off-centre from the reagent art
issues.note: Rings used one fixed layout per icon count; the scanned cards place icons by hand. Rings now use each card's measured icon centres (tools/measure_reagent_icons.py).

issues.description: BLOOM heading O letters overlapped; text on and around cards too small
issues.note: Cinzel Decorative kerns o·o, h·e, i·E by a third to a half em; display text turns kerning off. Bumped text stays at 13 px or more.

issues.description: Eye toggle: see the players' inventory from any screen and return to it unchanged
issues.note: The inventory has its own layer above the overlays, so closeAll and AI-turn closes leave it alone. While it is open, settle, AI steps, AI banners, arena playback and the keep commit wait; eye and inventory taps never skip an AI move or land a gather.

issues.description: Turn steps card: floating ? shows the turn in rules order and the step in progress, from any screen
issues.note: Shares the eye's suspend logic (app/js/peek.js): while the card is open settle, AI steps, banners, arena playback and the keep commit wait. Over an overlay the card reads the step from the overlay's data-turn-step mark (cast picker, put-back) or its testid.

issues.description: Players inventory: tapping a card no longer enlarged it (eye inventory)
issues.note: #149 drew the eye inventory's cards with no tap handler (view-only), and the sheet sits on the peek layer above #overlays, so an enlarged card would have opened underneath it. Inventory cards now open expandCard on the peek layer; on both sheets the swipe group is that player's whole mat in display order.

fixes_without_a_report.description: Familiar-enabled cast folds into its summon/rise entry
Turn order: cause before effect, incl. Energy Circle triggers
Gathered reagents land on the dock (or AI banner) one by one; counts, storage, tracks and turn wait for the landings
Casting Crystal Ball shows a crystal ball over the board for about 1.6 s; it takes no taps, leaves the hand at 5 cards and is removed afterward

not_gameplay.why: relay tests of the Report Bug button
visual or layout enhancements, no game logic
